programme.title: Compile BA
programme.desc: Compile BA - Les bandes annonces des meilleurs films : Spéciale acteurs: Ryan Gosling: Retrouvez toutes les bandes annonces de vos films et séries préférés regroupées par thème, genre ou encore par date de sortie.

programme.title: Allociné
programme.desc: Les émissions cultes, les meilleures bandes annonces de vos films et séries préférés, tout y est !

programme.title: Smiley Face Killers
programme.desc: Un joueur de foot se sent poursuivi par quelque chose, quelqu'un.

programme.title: Massacre au Palais du rire
programme.desc: Six psychopathes s'évadent d'un asile et transforment un Halloween Funhouse en cauchemar, semant la terreur.

programme.title: Riot : Enfermé pour tuer
programme.desc: Le flic Jack Stone braque une banque de la mafia russe et finit en prison avec le tueur de sa femme.

programme.title: Ennemis jurés
programme.desc: Deux ennemis jurés s'allient pour faire face à un cartel impitoyable à la frontière canado-américaine.

programme.title: The Big Ugly
programme.desc: Les relations anglo-américaines se détériorent quand des mafieux londoniens investissent en Virginie.

programme.title: Alone together
programme.desc: June, critique gastronomique, se rend dans le nord de l'État de New York pour une courte escapade romantique afin d'échapper à la pandémie qui sévit en ville.

programme.title: Entre les jambes
programme.desc: Tout commence lors d'une réunion des sexopathes anonymes où Javier et Miranda se rencontrent. Javier, scénariste-producteur, avait un avenir brillant jusqu'au jour où il s'est livré à un jeu sexuel au téléphone qui a détruit son mariage et Miranda, animatrice d'une émission radio.

programme.title: Une nouvelle chance (2016)
programme.desc: Un avenir de jeune chef tendait les bras à Charlie. Pourtant sa vie semble s'être suspendue, habitant avec sa mère et son beau-père et travaillant dans le cinéma de son quartier, Charlie n'a plus de motivation pour rien...

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: Mark a une vie de rêve : il est sur le point de devenir multimillionnaire et d'épouser son amour de jeunesse, Connie. Mais les choses ne sont parfaites qu'en surface : Mark découvre par hasard que Connie ne l'aime pas et compte juste voler sa fortune une fois le mariage prononcé.

programme.title: Flashbacks d'un fou
programme.desc: Daniel Craig livre une performance étonnante dans le rôle de Joe Scot, une star hollywoodienne has-been à la dérive plongé dans un brouillard de sexe, de drogues et de gloire dilapidée.

programme.title: Le mystère de Noël
programme.desc: L'histoire d'un petit village comme les autres. Mais dans ce petit village, ils ont tendance à avoir une mauvaise mémoire. Ils sont tellement oublieux. Encore et encore. Cette année, ils oublient que c'est l'heure de Noël.

programme.title: Après Lucia
programme.desc: Lucia est morte dans un accident de voiture il y a six mois depuis, son mari Roberto et sa fille Alejandra, tentent de surmonter ce deuil. Afin de prendre un nouveau départ, Roberto décide de s'installer à Mexico. Alejandra se retrouve, nouvelle, dans une classe. Plus jolie, plus brillante, elle est rapidement la cible d'envie et de jalousie de la part de ses camarades. Refusant d'en parler à son père, elle devient une proie, un bouc émissaire.

programme.title: La messagère
programme.desc: Après avoir frôlé la mort, Ellie Daly est terrifiée de réaliser qu'elle est capable de voir et de parler avec les morts. De retour chez elle, elle est abordée par le fantôme furieux d'une femme morte, qui accuse le mystérieux et séduisant nouveau voisin d'Ellie de son propre meurtre brutal.

programme.title: Rosie Davis
programme.desc: Rosie raconte l'histoire d'une mère qui tente de protéger sa famille suite à la vente de sa maison louée par son propriétaire et qui se retrouve sans abri.

programme.title: The Elite
programme.desc: Après que leurs familles ont été tuées par une bombe terroriste, cinq jeunes adultes sont formés en tant qu'équipe antiterroriste de haute technologie avec pour mission de rechercher et de détruire des groupes terroristes de haut niveau.

programme.title: Le Voyage Fantastique: Des Freres Bodganov
programme.desc: Le Voyage Fantastique: Des Freres Bodganov - Épisode 01: Une série innovante qui éclaire des sujets captivants : 1- Sommes-nous seuls dans l'univers? Explorez la possibilité de communiquer avec d'autres mondes. 2- Risques cosmiques : Les rayons gamma, les supervolcans et les inversions des pôles magnétiques peuvent-ils détruire la Terre? 3- Le côté caché du cerveau: Nouvelles théories basées sur des individus uniques avec une puissance cérébrale incroyable.

programme.title: Beyond the Sky
programme.desc: Au cours du tournage d'un documentaire sur les mensonges des enlèvements par des aliens, un réalisateur et son équipe rencontrent une jeune femme avec un terrible secret.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: The New Captain Scarlet - Épisode 06: Situé en 2068, Captain Scarlet suit la "guerre psychologique" entre la Terre et les Mysterons, une race martienne qui possède un contrôle partiel sur la matière. Lorsqu'un malentendu pousse des astronautes humains à attaquer leur ville sur Mars, les Mysterons jurent de se venger et lancent une série de représailles contre la Terre.

programme.title: Arthur et Merlin
programme.desc: D'après la légende, dans l'ancienne Grande-Bretagne, des forces saxonnes venues de l'est attaquent le peuple celte. Le druide Aberthol s'y attèle aussi. Mais tout n'est pas perdu. Arthur, un guerrier banni, et Merlin, un sorcier ermite, s'unissent, tels des héros, pour sauver le peuple.

programme.title: Fire Girls
programme.desc: Un célèbre tueur à gages de L.A. tombe amoureux de sa cible.

programme.title: Burlesque
programme.desc: Ali est une fille à la voix incroyable venant d'une petite ville. Elle décide de fuir les difficultés et un avenir incertain pour poursuivre ses rêves à Los Angeles. Ali trouve alors un travail de serveuse au Burlesque Lounge, un théâtre musical majestueux mais en grande perte de vitesse.

programme.title: Loverboy
programme.desc: Devenue mère, une femme délaissée par ses parents étant jeune en arrive à trop couver son fils de sept ans. Sa rencontre avec un homme va changer la vie du jeune garçon, qui voit en cet étranger une figure paternelle…

programme.title: The Diary of A Teenage Girl
programme.desc: Comme la plupart des adolescentes, Minnie Goetze (Bel Powley) espère être aimée, acceptée et trouver sa place dans le monde. Minnie a une liaison complexe avec le petit ami de sa mère (Kristen Wiig), le plus bel homme du monde, Monroe Rutherford (Alexander Skarsgard). Ce film drôle, décalé et provocateur dépeint l'éveil sexuel et artistique d'une jeune fille, mais sans porter de jugement. San Francisco, 1976. THE DIARY OF A TEENAGE GIRL se déroule à la fin du mouvement hippie et à l'aube de l'ère du punk rock. Sur fond de procès de Patty Hearst, Minnie découvre une ville en transition où sont confrontés des personnages perdus illustrant la rébellion des adolescents et les responsabilités des adultes. Entre une mère qui passe son temps à faire la fête et un père absent, Minnie manque de repères. Elle trouve du réconfort dans le sourire séducteur de Monroe et dans les ruelles de la baie de San Francisco. Dans ce monde déroutant et instable, l'animation sert de refuge à Minnie. Elle décide d'assumer sa sexualité et son goût pour le dessin, et ses nouveaux talents révèlent des vérités typiques d'un journal intime d'adolescente.

programme.title: Enzo Le Croco
programme.desc: Basé sur la série de livres à succès Lyle, Lyle, Crocodile de Bernard Waber, ENZO LE CROCO est une comédie musicale mêlant prise de vue réelles et animation.Lorsque la famille Primm déménage à New York, leur jeune fils Josh peine à s'adapter à sa nouvelle école et à se faire de nouveaux amis.

programme.title: Next Day Air
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un chauffeur-livreur livre par inadvertance un colis qui contient des briques de cocaïne cachées à la mauvaise adresse, cela déclenche une quête et une bataille désespérées pour la cocaïne entre le trafiquant furieux qui l'a envoyée

programme.title: En chantier, Monsieur Tanner !
programme.desc: Monsieur Tanner, reporter animalier, hérite d'un manoir. Sur place, il constate que la bâtisse est en mauvais état et que des travaux avaient commencé. Paul décide de poursuivre la rénovation.

programme.title: Le carrefour du parc
programme.desc: 10 personnes, 5 voitures, 1 jour… seulement à Los Angeles. « Park » se déroule en une journée, dans un parc public de Los Angeles, alors que 11 résidents mécontents trouvent à la fois l'amour et la perte de façon inattendue.

programme.title: Big movie
programme.desc: La parodie ultime des plus grands blockbusters, de X-Men à Pirates des Caraïbes en passant par le Monde de Narnia et Harry Potter.

programme.title: L'ange et le mauvais garçon
programme.desc: Quirt Evans, un méchant tout court, est soigné et recherché par Penelope Worth, une jeune fille quaker. Il finit par devoir choisir entre son monde et celui dans lequel vit Pénélope.

programme.title: Je vais... je tire... et je reviens
programme.desc: Un gang dérobe une cargaison d'or dans un train. Un soi-disant chasseur de primes est envoyé à la recherche des voleurs et décide de les laisser le conduire jusqu'à l'or.

programme.title: Hercule contre les tyrans de Babylone
programme.desc: Le roi Shalmaneser, Assur et sa sœur sorcière Tanit, tyrans de Babylone, retiennent prisonniers des Hellènes, dont Esperia, reine d'Hellas. Hercule intervient pour la sauver, punir les tyrans cruels et libérer le peuple.

programme.title: La Charge des Cosaques
programme.desc: L'histoire de Hadji Murad, un chef tchétchène du XIXe siècle qui a mené ses guerriers dans une lutte contre les forces d'invasion du tsar russe.

programme.title: Claw
programme.desc: Tandis qu'ils se rendaient vers Los Angeles pour une soirée humoristique, deux meilleurs amis, Kyle et Julia, doivent passer la nuit dans une ville fantôme à cause d'une crevaison. Contre leur gré, ils s'installent dans une caravane fournie par un étrange gardien, Ray.

programme.title: The Witch In The Window
programme.desc: Lorsque Simon, père divorcé, amène son fils de douze ans, Finn, dans une région rurale du Vermont pour aider à remettre en état une ancienne ferme, ils rencontrent l'esprit malin de Lydia, l'ancienne propriétaire, décédée bien que n'ayant jamais quitté les lieux.

programme.title: Attaque De Requin
programme.desc: Alors que l'armée s'attend au pire un homme semble avoir la solution.Ce jeune étudiant parviendra t-il à sauver le monde ?

programme.title: Deepwater
programme.desc: Après avoir été victime d'un accident, Nat Banyon recherche un emploi dans une ferme du Wyoming. Sur sa route, il sauve la vie de l'excentrique Herman Finch. Pour le remercier, celui-ci l'héberge et lui propose un emploi : remettre à neuf son motel.

programme.title: White Settlers
programme.desc: C'est la première nuit d'Ed et Sarah dans leur nouvelle maison : une ferme isolée à la frontière de l'Ecosse. Alors qu'ils pensaient échapper au stress de leur vie londonienne, le sommeil de Sarah est troublé par des bruits suspects. Leur nouvelle vie se transforme en cauchemar lorsque le couple part faire des investigations dans les bois à la nuit tombée. Ils réalisent alors qu'ils ne sont pas ici chez eux et encore moins les bienvenus.

programme.title: Hot Summer nights
programme.desc: Daniel, un adolescent maladroit, se retrouve durant un été torride à Cap Cod à la tête d'un trafic de drogue, tout en tombant amoureux de McKayla, l'énigmatique sœur de son associé.

programme.title: Troisième étoile à droite
programme.desc: James et ses amis proches poursuivent un voyage malavisé le long des côtes du Pays-de-Galles. Dans cette aventure touchante et comique, l'amitié, l'héroïsme et l'amour vont se côtoyer.

programme.title: The Peanut Butter Falcon
programme.desc: Une petite frappe en cavale va devenir le coach de catch et allié de Zak, un jeune homme trisomique. Zak a quitté son foyer pour réaliser son rêve : devenir catcheur professionnel.

programme.title: Manipulation
programme.desc: Alors que Doug a une liaison avec Lena, la mort suspecte du mari de cette dernière révèle l'existence d'une assurance vie conséquente..

programme.title: Jack Strong
programme.desc: L'espion polonais le plus spectaculaire de l'époque de la guerre froide, le colonel Ryszard Kuklinski, informe les Américains des plus grands secrets du bloc communiste face à l'imminence de la loi martiale.

programme.title: Flashbacks of a Fool
programme.desc: Daniel Craig livre une performance étonnante dans le rôle de Joe Scot, une star hollywoodienne has-been à la dérive plongé dans un brouillard de sexe, de drogues et de gloire dilapidée.

programme.title: Le tueur de l'autoroute
programme.desc: Un père de famille arrogant et énervé au volant se retrouve poursuivi et terrorisé par le conducteur d'un van qu'il a collé d'un peu trop près et qui souhaite prendre sa revanche.

programme.title: BA DRAMA 4 Minute Mile
programme.desc: Découvrez les bandes annonces des films à l'affiche sur les chaînes Box Office

programme.title: La Vague
programme.desc: Un professeur de lycée cherche à expliquer à ses élèves ce qu'est la vie sous une dictature. L'expérience tourne mal alors que ses élèves échappent à son contrôle.

programme.title: In Search of Darkness
programme.desc: Plongez dans l'horreur des années 80 avec cette conclusion gargantuesque qui s'attaque à l'âge d'or de la VHS et des vidéoclubs, dresse les portraits d'artistes et artisans incontournables et aborde de nombreuses pépites oubliées d'un cinéma imaginatif, sanglant, expérimental, indispensable…

programme.title: Uberlinks
programme.desc: Claude et Mahalia ont matché sur une application de rencontre pour personnes dotées de super-pouvoirs. Celui de Claude ? Devenir invisible. Quand Mahalia insiste pour connaître sa première action à la découverte de son pouvoir, Claude fait tout pour fuir la question. De peur de ruiner ses chances avec elle.

programme.title: Night Shot
programme.desc: Une jeune blogueuse spécialisée dans l'exploration urbaine (urbex) décide d'aller visiter un gigantesque hôpital abandonné. Comme toujours elle part seule et de nuit avec son cameraman, afin de faire vivre en direct ses aventures à ses followers, avec une particularité : ne jamais couper la caméra ! Mais ce soir le lieu qu'elle a choisi va lui faire vivre un véritable cauchemar, les drames du passé y ont laissé leurs traces…

programme.title: In Search of Darkness
programme.desc: Plongez dans l'horreur des années 80 avec cette conclusion gargantuesque qui s'attaque à l'âge d'or de la VHS et des vidéoclubs, dresse les portraits d'artistes et artisans incontournables et aborde de nombreuses pépites oubliées d'un cinéma imaginatif, sanglant, expérimental, indispensable…

programme.title: Scanners
programme.desc: Une société cherche à regrouper les Scanners, des médiums aux pouvoirs surnaturels. Elle recrute un jeune médium pour détecter tous les Scanners qui lui sont opposés. Il va découvrir les aspects cachés de cette périlleuse mission.

programme.title: Faux Semblants
programme.desc: Deux vrais jumeaux, gynécologues de renom, partagent vraiment tout dans leur vie. Un jour, une actrice vient les consulter et les deux frères en tombent amoureux...

programme.title: La Malédiction des profondeurs et Rottweiler
programme.desc: La Malédiction des profondeurs et Rottweiler

programme.title: Deadly Cargo
programme.desc: Cinq amis partent faire de la plongée sous-marine et découvrent le cadavre d'un homme flottant à la surface. Leur bateau ayant coulé peu après suite à une avarie, ils se retrouvent seuls au milieu de l'océan.

programme.title: Dagon
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un voilier s'échoue sur la côte espagnole, deux naufragés cherchent refuge à Imboca, un village isolé. Mais derrière son apparente ruine, la ville cache une secte vouée à Dagon, une divinité marine avide de sacrifices.

programme.title: Continental Split
programme.desc: Une faille menace de diviser les États-Unis. Une équipe doit empêcher la catastrophe.

programme.title: The Ranger
programme.desc: Des ados punks qui tentent d'échapper à la police en se cachant dans les bois se retrouvent face aux autorités locales - un garde forestier déséquilibré bien décidé à en découdre.

programme.title: Blood Circus
programme.desc: Un ancien champion du monde de MMA se voit enrôlé dans un club de combat souterrain appelé "Le Cirque du Sang" et se retrouve forcé de se battre pour survivre et sauver sa famille.

programme.title: Dementia 13
programme.desc: En Irlande, une série de meurtres à la hache provoque la terreur.

programme.title: Mutant Legacy
programme.desc: Un groupe de mutants parias, dont une jeune femme dotée de super-force se retrouve traqué par un sinistre organisme gouvernemental.

programme.title: Un Justicier Dans La Ville
programme.desc: Après le meurtre de sa femme et le viol de sa fille, un architecte bascule dans la violence. Il arpente New York à la recherche de criminels à châtier. Fondateur des vigilante movies, le film est plus une réflexion sur la violence dans la culture américaine qu'un plaidoyer pour l'autodéfense.

programme.title: Mission Alcatraz
programme.desc: Alcatraz vient de rouvrir. C'est aujourd'hui une prison de très haute sécurité, bénéficiant des toutes dernières techniques de surveillance. Alors que Sascha, un agent du FBI, s'y trouve enfermé pour une mission secrète, un commando prend d'assaut le célèbre pénitencier afin de faire libérer Lester, un détenu condamné à mort.

programme.title: Mission Alcatraz 2
programme.desc: Burk et Twitch sont deux taulards incarcérés dans la prison ultraviolente de Craton contrôlée par des gangs rivaux. Lorsqu'une émeute éclate, ils décident de s'allier, et pénètrent dans le territoire hostile du gang sous l'œil des gardiens de prison antipathiques, afin de découvrir qui a déclenché l'émeute. Burk apprend enfin que c'est le chef de gang Cortez, qui a pris deux otages : Cherise, la fiancée de Twitch, et Ellie, la fille de Burk. Twitch et Burk décident de travailler ensemble pour sauver celles qu'ils aiment et faire tomber Cortez.

programme.title: Krull
programme.desc: Le Prince Colwyn entreprend un périple risqué pour sauver sa promise, retenue captive par la Bête. Mais à chaque détour du chemin, il se retrouve face aux assassins et aux aliens commandés par la Bête. Colwyn doit d'abord atteindre une grotte pour retrouver le Glaive légendaire, qui lui donnera des pouvoirs phénoménaux, avant de poursuivre sa quête et être le témoin d'événements inimaginables.

programme.title: D-War: La Guerre Des Dragons
programme.desc: Des créatures semblables à des dragons venus d'une ancienne légende apparaissent dans Los Angeles, escaladent les gratte-ciel, lancent des voitures et terrorisent la ville à la recherche d'une fille appelée Sarah. Alors qu'il enquête sur les sites touchés, un journaliste de télévision, Ethan, découvre un morceau de débris qui le relie directement à cette légende.

programme.title: Contaminations

programme.desc: This is the story of an awe-inspiring land of extremes. From the cold and fearsome waters of Tierra Del Fuego and the Antarctic Peninsula to the frozen Patagonian steppe, we follow the animals living on the very edge of existence, having to survive is some of the most extreme environments on earth. King Penguins court on the windswept coast leopard seals hunt amongst the ice floes and young pumas take their first steps toward independence is this South American final Frontier.

programme.title: Lion

Together, they'll hunt, raise their young and defend their territory. With such a close family and plentiful home, the pride welcomes new babies every year. But new children introduces new dangers. The cubs will have to trust their instincts, their mother and the power of the pride if they are to make it to adulthood and take their place on the African plains.

programme.desc: Tasmania's Bonorong Wildlife Sanctuary used to be a traditional wildlife park - now it is an innovative and active wildlife sanctuary and home to the famous Tasmanian Devil, to wombats, and many other native species. But unfortunately, "Tassie Devils" are particularly endangered by the Devil Facial Tumor Disease (DFTD). We accompany the team of young, ambitious scientists on their fight against the disease.

programme.title: Wildlife Diaries Australia
programme.desc: Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary was opened in 1927 at a time when Koalas were still being killed on a large scale for the fur trade. Today, hardly anything threatens the natural habitats of these animals as much as the desertification of the forests. We let the drones fly and are there when a new tree is planted.

programme.title: Wildlife Diaries Australia

programme.title: Wildlife Diaries Australia
programme.desc: Australia's largest fur seal colony is located on Phillip Island. Night after night, a breathtaking spectacle takes place here: At sunset, countless fairy penguins return from their hunt for fish. In the station near the penguin colony, pioneering scientific research is conducted around the cute animals. We learn how dedicated scientists are trying to secure the future of the fairy penguins with the help of GPS trackers.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Egg jangjorim is perfect when you need a quick side dish to complete your meal. The taste is richer and less salty than regular beef-based jangjorim. You can easily finish a bowl of rice with this addictive dish only.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: A road trip experience in Korea is not complete without a stopover at a highway rest stop. One of the classic foods available at these stops is the hearty Gyeongsang-do Province style spicy beef soup packed with Korean radish and bean sprouts. Another delicacy is rice cakes with sausages skewered together and glazed with spicy sauce.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Gukbap is one of the delicacies in Busan made of pork bone broth and pork slices served with rice. The origin of this delicious and hearty treat dates back to the Korean War when refugees made a broth out of pork bones which were more readily available than ox bones.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Tofu is an affordable source of protein and a versatile ingredient in Korean cuisine. Dubu gangjeong is pan-fried crunchy tofu tossed in sweet and sour sauce. Even kids who don't like eating tofu will enjoy this healthy and savory dish.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Highway rest stops in Korea are a great place to enjoy local delicacies. An example would be kkomak bibimbap in Boseong which is a bowl of rice topped with chubby cockles and assorted vegetables and served with spicy sauce. Other popular foods found at rest stops include hot bar, a fish cake bar made from white fish fillet, squid and vegetables.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Spring is in the air with trees and flowers bursting into life. What better season to have a picnic with your family and friends? We have prepared some quick and easy recipes featuring seasonal ingredients that you can try at your next picnic, including rice balls, bacon-wrapped rice cake, fresh fruits and strawberry juice.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chef Ryan shares with us how to make danhobakjuk, a sweet pumpkin porridge. Boiled sweet pumpkin is simmered with glutinous rice flour and garnished with chewy little rice cake balls and a few pumpkin seeds. As the temperature drops, there's nothing like this comforting dish to warm you up. With its rich flavors, danhobakjuk truly captures the taste of autumn.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Bomdong, or spring cabbage, signals the arrival of spring. Rich in vitamin c, these greens are sweet and savory. When added to the doenjang soybean paste soup, bomdong leaves help remove sodium in the paste, while giving a refreshing kick. Try these recipes to liven up your spring table!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Fish cake and noodles simmered in a savory broth is a popular and filling food at rest stops. After indulging in the hearty soup, try roasted butter potatoes with a crispy outside and a tender inside.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Dried pollock fish, bean curd and bean sprouts are simmered in a rich stock to make a hangover soup great for breakfast. After indulging in this tasty and filling soup, try a deep fried spiral-cut whole potato on a skewer. These two delicacies will keep you fueled for the rest of your trip.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: During the May 18 Democratization Movement, a popular uprising against the military regime in Korea in 1980, women made jumeokbap, or rice balls to feed the freedom fighters. The food became a symbol of solidarity and sharing. Try these recipes that will help us remember the spirit of the watershed moment in Korean democracy.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chef Ryan shares with us how to make bibim makguksu, or spicy buckwheat noodles that are sure to light up your appetite this spring. Cold, springy buckwheat noodles are topped with fresh vegetables and fruits and a spicy sauce. We will make the traditional Korean version, as well as the international version that uses ingredients that are more readily available elsewhere in the world.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Fall crabs packed with meat are tossed in a sweet and spicy sauce. These spicy raw crabs are known as “rice thief,” as your bowl of rice will be gone in no time. Another delicious recipe that uses a seasonal ingredient is a hearty and refreshing soybean sprout soup made with seasonal oysters.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Eggplants are summer vegetables rich in Vitamin E. If you are not a big fan of their mushy texture, try gochujang gaji deopbap with lightly stir-fried eggplant tossed in spicy chili paste. A perfect dish to pair up with it is oi naengguk, a refreshing summer soup made of cucumbers that are known to cool body heat due to high moisture content.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: The gizzard shad is one of the most popular seasonal fish in fall. It is braised in a spicy and sweet sauce to make a delicious fish dish that is sure to light up your appetite. Pair it with steamed lotus root tossed with perilla seeds, another delicacy made of seasonal ingredients.

programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We're here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you're in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they're going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they're all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let's see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: U-KNOW 'I-KNOW' Spoiler Film
programme.desc: TVXQ! U-Know released a spy-style ‘I-KNOW' Spoiler Film to heighten anticipation for his upcoming comeback. Clues like word puzzles and coins, combined with the rhythm of “Body Language,” hint at the overall concept of the album.

programme.title: U-KNOW 'Body Language' MV
programme.desc: “Body Language” is a dance track blending blues, funk, and retro hip-hop, delivering a message of unity through dance. TVXQ! U-Know's lively vocals and performance amplify the song's upbeat and cheerful energy.The music video artistically portrays villagers coming together through dance, with choreography by Vata of WeDemBoyz and RIEHATA of RIEHATOKYO. TVXQ! U-Know kicks off his first full-length album ‘I-KNOW' promotions with the pre-release of the new track “Body Language.”

programme.title: U-KNOW 'Set In Stone' MV
programme.desc: The album opens with the intro track “Set In Stone,” an energetic pop song built around a powerful synthesizer riff. With its straightforward melody and strong rhythm, the track delivers Yunho's determination to “engrave the self I've preserved through doubt and confusion firmly in stone.”TVXQ's U-KNOW has completed his own musical world with his first full-length album, “I-KNOW.”

programme.title: U-KNOW 'Stretch' MV
programme.desc: The title track “Stretch” is a pop song characterized by its powerful electronic sound, with murmured vocals that create a striking contrast and deliver a sense of tension. Furthermore, the “Stretch” music video captures U-KNOW facing his inner shadow and engaging in a tense confrontation, portrayed through cinematic visuals and intense performance. It is also narratively connected to the previously released “Body Language” music video, adding greater depth and dimension to the world of this album.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Mood Sampler #1 | Chapter 1. How2getHearts
programme.desc: The group's vibrant visuals are paired with STELLA's captivating English narration.Hearts2Hearts' first mood sampler for their debut mini album 'FOCUS' features a rulebook concept video that shows how the members "earn hearts."

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Mood Sampler #2 | Chapter 2. Hard2Hide
programme.desc: Hearts2Hearts' second mood sampler for their debut mini album 'FOCUS' captures the members expressing the range of emotions experienced when falling in love, such as excitement, imagination, jealousy, sadness, and obsession.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Trailer
programme.desc: The album trailer captures the members' bold and free-spirited sides as they play around and dance together in a quiet space. In the latter part of the video, the title track “FOCUS” audio and part of the choreography are revealed, raising anticipation for the new release.Hearts2Hearts' first mini album FOCUS features a total of six tracks, including the title track “FOCUS,” the single “STYLE,” and the pre-release song “Pretty Please,” showcasing a diverse musical palette.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' MV
programme.desc: Set against a school backdrop, the music video delicately captures the complex emotions between the members. Its lyrics sensually express the feeling of being completely focused on someone, offering a fresh glimpse into Hearts2Hearts' unique appeal. Choreographed by Jo Na-In, the performance delivers a sleek and sophisticated atmosphere.Hearts2Hearts' first mini album title track “FOCUS” is a house genre-based song that features a vintage piano riff and an addictive melody, showcasing the group's cool and chic vocal charm.

programme.title: RIIZE 'Fame' Trailer
programme.desc: It expresses the members' moments of anxiety, emptiness, and the intense emotions that arise amid their struggles, all captured through RIIZE's unique genre of “emotional pop.”RIIZE's new single “Fame” is set to be released. Focusing on the unseen side of RIIZE's growth journey, the single features a total of three tracks, including the title track “Fame.”

programme.title: NCT DREAM : They Were Here To Beat It Up Trailer
programme.desc: The trailer “They Were Here To Beat It Up” wittily portrays NCT DREAM breaking through their limits and opening a new chapter of their own stage with surreal visuals and storytelling, powerfully setting the tone for the beginning of the new album.NCT DREAM's 6th mini album “Beat It Up” consists of six tracks, including the title track of the same name, “Beat It Up.” Centering on the theme of “the speed of time,” the album delivers a bold message that the members — who have been running toward their dreams since childhood — continue to grow, while confidently moving forward at their own pace and in their own way.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Best and Bester
programme.desc: It's election day in Bettervale! Later, Best and Bester accidentally list their Sub as a hotel online and are surprised by a booking from Lottie Snott, the star of their favourite TV detective series!

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: Chased Dreamers
programme.desc: To craft their own hourglasses and become official Dream Chasers for the Night Bureau, Mateo and his friends must defeat the Dream Forge guardian.

programme.title: The Dream Forge
programme.desc: As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers, Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: When the girls go to Mia's grandparents' ranch and Olivia accidentally knocks down the neighbor's barn, the girls promise to raise money to rebuild it and now have to learn to set aside their differences and work together to make good on their promise. Mia invites her friends to her grandparents' ranch for the weekend. But when Olivia accidentally knocks down a neighbor's barn with a tractor, the girls promise to raise the money to rebuild it themselves. Complicating matters, Mia and Stephanie turn out to like the same boy, Martin. They'll have to learn to set aside their differences and work together if they're going to raise enough money to make good on their promise.

programme.title: Emma's Dilemma
programme.desc: When Stephanie becomes obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in a float building contest and accidentally disregards Emma's ideas and design, Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to get revenge on Stephanie. When the girls enter a float-building contest, Emma is especially excited to share her design idea for the float. But no one is listening to her, especially Stephanie, who's become obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in the contest. Emma finally does find someone who appreciates her design… Tanya! Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to build the float design. But is Tanya just using Emma to get revenge on Stephanie?

programme.title: Friends of The Jungle
programme.desc: When Olivia's Aunt Sophie is getting married and the groom has gone missing in the jungle, the girls fly out to the jungle in secret to try to find him in time for the wedding. The girls are super excited to be planning a wedding for Olivia's Aunt Sophie. There's just one little problem: Olivia learns that the groom has gone missing in the jungle while working at an animal rescue station! Not wanting to worry her aunt, Olivia, Stephanie and Mia secretly fly to the jungle to try and find the groom, Henry, rescuing a few animals along the way. Too bad Emma and Andrea couldn't keep the secret back in Heartlake City. Now, Sophie, Emma and Andrea join the others in the jungle to try and find Henry before the rapidly approaching wedding date!

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Baby's Marvelous Toy: It's been a few hundred years since Grandpa Smurf has seen this old toy… It was given to Papa Smurf long, long ago and he does not remember what it does. But Baby Smurf does know that it brings surprises for everyone!

programme.title: He Who Smurfs Last
programme.desc: Jokey's practical jokes go too far when Chlorhydris is the victim of one. She gets her revenge on the Smurfs by creating a spell to steal their sense of humor. Grouchy, who had no sense of humor to begin with, breaks the spell by getting back the humor potion.

programme.title: Jokey's Medecine
programme.desc: Because of Jokey's pranks, none of the Smurfs believe him when he tells them that Azrael the cat is ready to pounce on them. Feeling guilty and responsible, he hurries to Gargamel's castle and plays some explosive jokes on the wizard and his cat so he can free his friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Royal Drum: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Kow-Tow, We Won't Bow: Smurfette leads the Smurflings on a nature hike, but Puppy gets too far ahead and they chase him into the land of the Wartmongers. King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf On The Wild Side, Part I: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Snappy's Puppet: Snappy has a new trick: he frightens everybody, or tries to, with his hand-puppet dragon. But it gets, shall we say, out of hand when Papa Smurf's magic liquid falls on the puppet and it comes alive. Alive and kicking, what's more, endangering Snappy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - No Smurf Is An Island: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Crooner Smurf: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Baby Smurf Is Missing: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Smurfing Out Of Time: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Greedy And The Porridge Pot: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

He explains how, ahead of the other shepherds protecting their flock with him, he is flown away by the Angel Gabriel, to be the first visitor to the newly born Christ child. programme.title: U-KNOW 'I-KNOW' Spoiler Film
programme.desc: TVXQ! U-Know released a spy-style ‘I-KNOW' Spoiler Film to heighten anticipation for his upcoming comeback. Clues like word puzzles and coins, combined with the rhythm of “Body Language,” hint at the overall concept of the album.

programme.title: U-KNOW 'Body Language' MV
programme.desc: “Body Language” is a dance track blending blues, funk, and retro hip-hop, delivering a message of unity through dance. TVXQ! U-Know's lively vocals and performance amplify the song's upbeat and cheerful energy.The music video artistically portrays villagers coming together through dance, with choreography by Vata of WeDemBoyz and RIEHATA of RIEHATOKYO. TVXQ! U-Know kicks off his first full-length album ‘I-KNOW' promotions with the pre-release of the new track “Body Language.”

programme.title: U-KNOW 'Set In Stone' MV
programme.desc: The album opens with the intro track “Set In Stone,” an energetic pop song built around a powerful synthesizer riff. With its straightforward melody and strong rhythm, the track delivers Yunho's determination to “engrave the self I've preserved through doubt and confusion firmly in stone.”TVXQ's U-KNOW has completed his own musical world with his first full-length album, “I-KNOW.”

programme.title: U-KNOW 'Stretch' MV
programme.desc: The title track “Stretch” is a pop song characterized by its powerful electronic sound, with murmured vocals that create a striking contrast and deliver a sense of tension. Furthermore, the “Stretch” music video captures U-KNOW facing his inner shadow and engaging in a tense confrontation, portrayed through cinematic visuals and intense performance. It is also narratively connected to the previously released “Body Language” music video, adding greater depth and dimension to the world of this album.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Mood Sampler #1 | Chapter 1. How2getHearts
programme.desc: The group's vibrant visuals are paired with STELLA's captivating English narration.Hearts2Hearts' first mood sampler for their debut mini album 'FOCUS' features a rulebook concept video that shows how the members "earn hearts."

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Mood Sampler #2 | Chapter 2. Hard2Hide
programme.desc: Hearts2Hearts' second mood sampler for their debut mini album 'FOCUS' captures the members expressing the range of emotions experienced when falling in love, such as excitement, imagination, jealousy, sadness, and obsession.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Trailer
programme.desc: The album trailer captures the members' bold and free-spirited sides as they play around and dance together in a quiet space. In the latter part of the video, the title track “FOCUS” audio and part of the choreography are revealed, raising anticipation for the new release.Hearts2Hearts' first mini album FOCUS features a total of six tracks, including the title track “FOCUS,” the single “STYLE,” and the pre-release song “Pretty Please,” showcasing a diverse musical palette.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' MV
programme.desc: Set against a school backdrop, the music video delicately captures the complex emotions between the members. Its lyrics sensually express the feeling of being completely focused on someone, offering a fresh glimpse into Hearts2Hearts' unique appeal. Choreographed by Jo Na-In, the performance delivers a sleek and sophisticated atmosphere.Hearts2Hearts' first mini album title track “FOCUS” is a house genre-based song that features a vintage piano riff and an addictive melody, showcasing the group's cool and chic vocal charm.

programme.title: RIIZE 'Fame' Trailer
programme.desc: It expresses the members' moments of anxiety, emptiness, and the intense emotions that arise amid their struggles, all captured through RIIZE's unique genre of “emotional pop.”RIIZE's new single “Fame” is set to be released. Focusing on the unseen side of RIIZE's growth journey, the single features a total of three tracks, including the title track “Fame.”

programme.title: NCT DREAM : They Were Here To Beat It Up Trailer
programme.desc: The trailer “They Were Here To Beat It Up” wittily portrays NCT DREAM breaking through their limits and opening a new chapter of their own stage with surreal visuals and storytelling, powerfully setting the tone for the beginning of the new album.NCT DREAM's 6th mini album “Beat It Up” consists of six tracks, including the title track of the same name, “Beat It Up.” Centering on the theme of “the speed of time,” the album delivers a bold message that the members — who have been running toward their dreams since childhood — continue to grow, while confidently moving forward at their own pace and in their own way.

During the adventure, Meteo not only relied on his determination to protect the weak and gained recognition to unlock the power of the sacred beast, but also got acquainted with the hidden master Kim who came here to find his brother and Joll who wanted to prove as the “perfect warrior” to his father. programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Kahi Suni
programme.desc: In a land steeped in mysticism, spirituality, and religion, the imagination of the followers has much room to flourish. Stories abound – some based on truth and some only on fractions of the truth. Nevertheless, these stories have enchanted their listeners for eons. Kahi Suni packs away our skepticism and takes us on a ride through the legendary tales of India. Each destination covered in the episodes has been the birthplace of a legend and each legend has given rise to the recognition of that location. Following our host from north to south and east to west, we journey through the land of myths of legends uncovering the origins of evIery story.

programme.title: Parikrama
programme.desc: A journey to experience the most revered religious sites of India. A spiritual – travel series which unfolds untold stories and takes its viewers on a devotional journey."

programme.title: Sanrachna
programme.desc: Shelter - one of mankind's most basic physiological needs. At least that's what it started out as at the beginning of time. From dwelling in caves to carving out temples in mountains, mankind has redefined shelter with every passing era. Though the underlying philosophy of any monument is to serve some sort of function, great architecture is fuelled by imagination. India's architecture is built on that very imagination and is a fascinating fusion of both art and science. From strategically placed astronomy towers to impressive and awe-inspiring tombs, Indian architecture has pushed the limits of engineering and design. Sanrachna explores these architectural wonders and how the makers of these marvels made them without the aid of modern mechanics and machinery. With an immensely astute sense of engineering, the architects were able to construct fortresses that have stood the test of time, unshaken by its changes. Join our host Vaibhavi as she travels through the country discovering the fascinating stories behind India's outstanding monuments and its architecture. Sanrachna will leave you in awe of the past and its ability to do what we can't, even with our modern tools and fancy tricks.

programme.title: Ekaant
programme.desc: India is known for its remarkable architecture and serene landscapes. Its rich history is steeped in mystery its vastness - lends itself to several stories and urban legends. Ekaant takes you through the abandoned roads and alleys of some of India's historic locations. Travelling through the spread out palaces and deserted forts, the show documents and investigates the eerie processes of abandonment of each site. How flourishing towns and cities came to be in ruins, is the question each episode seeks to answer. Ekaant explores the ceasing of life and the triumph of nature even in the most populated of places and takes you on the road no longer travelled.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Epic
programme.desc: Designed to captivate the intelligent young minds from class 5 to 10, EPIC INDIA QUIZ CHALLENGE is a one-of-a-kind quiz competition where teams from schools across India will fight for the crown of having the highest ‘IQ' i.e. India Quotient. The show follows a unique, tailored for a nail-biting climax, format as it tests the contestants' India Quotient, their knowledge of the country- its culture, history, geography, current affairs, and more. Known for his quick wit and charm, popular Bollywood singer and actor Meiyang Chang hosts the show that celebrates India and its diversity.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Egg jangjorim is perfect when you need a quick side dish to complete your meal. The taste is richer and less salty than regular beef-based jangjorim. You can easily finish a bowl of rice with this addictive dish only.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: A road trip experience in Korea is not complete without a stopover at a highway rest stop. One of the classic foods available at these stops is the hearty Gyeongsang-do Province style spicy beef soup packed with Korean radish and bean sprouts. Another delicacy is rice cakes with sausages skewered together and glazed with spicy sauce.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Gukbap is one of the delicacies in Busan made of pork bone broth and pork slices served with rice. The origin of this delicious and hearty treat dates back to the Korean War when refugees made a broth out of pork bones which were more readily available than ox bones.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Tofu is an affordable source of protein and a versatile ingredient in Korean cuisine. Dubu gangjeong is pan-fried crunchy tofu tossed in sweet and sour sauce. Even kids who don't like eating tofu will enjoy this healthy and savory dish.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Highway rest stops in Korea are a great place to enjoy local delicacies. An example would be kkomak bibimbap in Boseong which is a bowl of rice topped with chubby cockles and assorted vegetables and served with spicy sauce. Other popular foods found at rest stops include hot bar, a fish cake bar made from white fish fillet, squid and vegetables.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Spring is in the air with trees and flowers bursting into life. What better season to have a picnic with your family and friends? We have prepared some quick and easy recipes featuring seasonal ingredients that you can try at your next picnic, including rice balls, bacon-wrapped rice cake, fresh fruits and strawberry juice.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chef Ryan shares with us how to make danhobakjuk, a sweet pumpkin porridge. Boiled sweet pumpkin is simmered with glutinous rice flour and garnished with chewy little rice cake balls and a few pumpkin seeds. As the temperature drops, there's nothing like this comforting dish to warm you up. With its rich flavors, danhobakjuk truly captures the taste of autumn.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Bomdong, or spring cabbage, signals the arrival of spring. Rich in vitamin c, these greens are sweet and savory. When added to the doenjang soybean paste soup, bomdong leaves help remove sodium in the paste, while giving a refreshing kick. Try these recipes to liven up your spring table!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Fish cake and noodles simmered in a savory broth is a popular and filling food at rest stops. After indulging in the hearty soup, try roasted butter potatoes with a crispy outside and a tender inside.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Dried pollock fish, bean curd and bean sprouts are simmered in a rich stock to make a hangover soup great for breakfast. After indulging in this tasty and filling soup, try a deep fried spiral-cut whole potato on a skewer. These two delicacies will keep you fueled for the rest of your trip.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: During the May 18 Democratization Movement, a popular uprising against the military regime in Korea in 1980, women made jumeokbap, or rice balls to feed the freedom fighters. The food became a symbol of solidarity and sharing. Try these recipes that will help us remember the spirit of the watershed moment in Korean democracy.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chef Ryan shares with us how to make bibim makguksu, or spicy buckwheat noodles that are sure to light up your appetite this spring. Cold, springy buckwheat noodles are topped with fresh vegetables and fruits and a spicy sauce. We will make the traditional Korean version, as well as the international version that uses ingredients that are more readily available elsewhere in the world.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Fall crabs packed with meat are tossed in a sweet and spicy sauce. These spicy raw crabs are known as “rice thief,” as your bowl of rice will be gone in no time. Another delicious recipe that uses a seasonal ingredient is a hearty and refreshing soybean sprout soup made with seasonal oysters.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Eggplants are summer vegetables rich in Vitamin E. If you are not a big fan of their mushy texture, try gochujang gaji deopbap with lightly stir-fried eggplant tossed in spicy chili paste. A perfect dish to pair up with it is oi naengguk, a refreshing summer soup made of cucumbers that are known to cool body heat due to high moisture content.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: The gizzard shad is one of the most popular seasonal fish in fall. It is braised in a spicy and sweet sauce to make a delicious fish dish that is sure to light up your appetite. Pair it with steamed lotus root tossed with perilla seeds, another delicacy made of seasonal ingredients.

programme.title: Saschiz Old Town, Romania
programme.desc: Saschiz, village, and commune, Mureș județ county is located in central Romania. The villages of Saschiz, Mihai Viteazu, and Cloașterf make up the larger commune of Saschiz. Located in the old region of Transylvania, it lies about 20 km east of Sighișoara"&". First documented in the 14th century, Saschiz is known for its medieval fortress and church constructed by Transylvanian Saxons, a German speaker. They settled in Transylvania when it was part of Hungary. The ruins of the 14th-century fortress sit atop "&"a hill overlooking the village. The late 15th-century fortified church has Gothic details and an imposing clock tower. Along with five other villages with fortified churches, Saschiz was inscribed on UNESCO's World Heritage sites in 1999.
